description: This file defines the 'Base64Attachment' class, a data transfer object (DTO) used to encapsulate file attachment information such as filename, file type, size, and base64-encoded content. It includes methods for creating instances from uploaded files or arrays, getting and setting properties, and decoding base64 content.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a file attachment encoded in base64, with properties for filename, file type, size, and content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the attachment with filename, file type, base64 content, and size.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file as a string.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getBase64Content
methods.description: Returns the base64-encoded content of the file.

methods.name: setBase64Content
methods.description: Sets the base64-encoded content of the file.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Decodes and returns the binary content of the base64 string, or null if decoding fails.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Encodes the provided binary content into base64 and sets it.

methods.name: createFromUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates an instance of Base64Attachment from a Symfony UploadedFile object.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance of Base64Attachment from an array with keys 'name', 'type', 'base64', and 'size'.
